title: 门店综合经营异常看板
context: 管理层需要优先检查经营异常的门店。
requirements: 2025年第四季度，门店净销售、毛利率、目标达成率、退款率（退款/退款前折后销售额）、净销售排名；异常项：毛利率<30%、达成率<90%、退款率>8%；按异常数降序。
commonError: 阈值用四舍五入后的比率可能误判边界。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost,SUM(refund_cents) refund FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-10' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id), p AS (SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net,100.0*(a.net-a.cost)/NULLIF(a.net,0) margin,100.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.target,0) attainment,100.0*a.refund/NULLIF(a.net+a.refund,0) refund_rate FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id), z AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN margin<30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN attainment<90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN refund_rate>8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END flags,RANK() OVER(ORDER BY net DESC) sales_rank FROM p) SELECT store_id,net net_cents,ROUND(margin,2) margin_pct,ROUND(attainment,2) achievement_pct,ROUND(refund_rate,2) refund_pct,flags,sales_rank FROM z ORDER BY flags DESC,store_id
